class.name: MLPNetwork
class.brief_description: A small dense neural network evaluated on the CPU.
class.description: An optional input normalisation followed by fully connected layers, each with an activation. Meant for control policies queried at tens of hertz, such as a physics character's learned locomotion, where a scripting language is too slow and a tensor runtime is more than needed. Load the weights of a trained network with [method add_layer], one layer at a time from the input, then call [method forward].

method.name: add_layer
method.description: Appends a fully connected layer. [param weights] is row-major, one row of [param inputs] values per output; the number of outputs is the size of [param bias]. [param inputs] must match the previous layer's outputs.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes every layer and the input normalisation.

method.name: forward
method.description: Evaluates the network on [param input], which must have [method get_input_size] values, and returns the last layer's outputs.

method.name: get_input_size
method.description: Returns the first layer's number of inputs, or [code]0[/code] without layers.

method.name: get_output_size
method.description: Returns the last layer's number of outputs, or [code]0[/code] without layers.

method.name: set_input_normalization
method.description: Normalises each input as [code](x - mean) * inv_std[/code] before the first layer, then clamps it to [code][-clip, clip][/code] if [param clip] is positive.
